functions.name: text
functions.description: Replace MiniApp text and optionally set its foreground color. Defaults to a readable system dark/light foreground; choose a color with readable contrast against the app's surfaces. ASCII/font coverage must be checked.

functions.name: clear
functions.description: Clear command canvas, no full-screen framebuffer allocation.

functions.name: rect
functions.bounds: current viewport (240x272 standard / 240x320 fullscreen); <=192 commands per frame

functions.name: set
functions.description: Atomic per-key commit; namespace/quota owned by OS.

functions.name: fetch
functions.limits: one network connection; response <=4096 B; <=3 reauthorized redirects

functions.name: http.request
functions.limits: manifest exact-domain allowlist; TLS verified; response <=8192 bytes; completion reports HTTP status and body; GET redirects are reauthorized and remain on the same origin when custom headers are used; POST redirects are not followed; reserved headers and CR/LF rejected

functions.name: ws_connect
functions.completion: on_http(101, "") when transport client starts; connection readiness is polled with ws_connected; inbound messages use on_message(bytes, opcode)
functions.limits: WSS only; manifest exact-domain allowlist; TLS verified; automatic reconnect disabled; bounded handshake headers; reserved WebSocket headers rejected; explicitly close/reconnect

functions.name: ws_connected
functions.description: Whether the current WSS transport is connected.

functions.name: ws_send
functions.limits: 50 sends/s, 16KiB/s, bounded internal queues; no lifetime byte quota

functions.name: json.decode
functions.limits: depth <=8, 256 values, string <=2048 bytes; duplicate keys and non-finite numbers rejected

functions.name: json.encode
functions.limits: depth <=8, 256 values, string <=2048 bytes, cyclic/sparse/mixed-key tables rejected

functions.name: system.public_device_identity
functions.returns: {device_id: Wi-Fi MAC, client_id: stable app-scoped UUID} or nil
functions.description: Read-only; requires the device.identity Manifest permission. No private hardware secrets are returned.

functions.name: audio.stream_start
functions.description: Starts OS Opus capture at 16 kHz mono, 60 ms frames; frames are delivered asynchronously through on_audio_frame. Requires foreground microphone consent.

functions.name: audio.stream_stop
functions.description: Stops capture while keeping the stream worker available for reply playback. Worker, codecs and queues are released on app exit or runtime fault.

functions.name: audio.play_opus
functions.description: Queue one 16 kHz mono, 60 ms Opus frame for OS decode and speaker playback; at most three frames are queued.

functions.name: microphone
functions.description: Requires system foreground consent. No raw PCM or network transmission.

functions.name: system.language
functions.description: Read the current system UI language. The value is set by the user and is available to every MiniApp.

functions.name: system.display_mode
functions.description: Read the current system appearance selected in Settings. Read-only; MiniApps choose whether to follow it or use their own colors.

functions.name: ui.icon
functions.description: Shared system registry; unknown IDs use system.app-default.

functions.name: graphics.sprite
functions.description: Session-owned native LVGL image; <=16 visible images; bounded encoded cache.

events.name: on_button
events.description: Backward-compatible alias for on_button_short; UP/DOWN fire on release, while OK waits for the 180 ms double-tap window.

events.name: on_button_down
events.description: Physical press edge, dispatched immediately. Pair with on_button_up for hold interactions such as push-to-talk.

events.name: on_button_short
events.description: Single short tap. UP/DOWN fire once on every release; OK fires after the 180 ms double-tap window.

events.name: on_button_double
events.description: Reserved for compatibility; no double callback is delivered to MiniApps. UP/DOWN taps are always singles; double OK is consumed by the OS to return Home.

events.name: on_audio_error
events.description: Asynchronous OS audio startup error. Code 1 means the stream worker could not start. Microphone consent remains granted; the app may retry after stopping the stream.

events.name: on_audio_frame
events.description: One encoded 16 kHz mono, 60 ms Opus frame; dispatched while audio.stream capture is active.

events.name: on_stop
events.description: Bounded cleanup; not guaranteed after VM fault. OS always releases resources.

events.name: on_button_long
events.description: Button held through the 1,800 ms long-press threshold.

events.name: on_button_up
events.description: Immediate physical button release edge; delivered for all three keys, including short taps, double taps, and long presses.

display.get_viewport: passport.display.get_viewport() (alias getViewport) -> width, height, safeInsets{left,top,right,bottom}, mode
display.mode_request: Not exposed to apps; signed manifest mode is fixed at launch.

native_hid.profile: encrypted bonded BLE HID mouse and Consumer Control
